cli.finalMessage:
Both files audit clean at 100/100.

The transactions screen is built: `Screen.tsx` renders a title, a `Card` with a `DataTableToolbar` (search field, category `Select`, `DateRangePicker`, and an outlined "Export CSV" button with `IconDownload`), and a `DataTable` of 12 mock transactions with sortable date/description/category/status/amount columns (status as a `Badge`, category as a `Tag`, amount as an `Amount` with sign and tone). Filtering combines search text, category and date range client-side; when nothing matches, the table's `emptyState` shows a `EmptyState` with a "Clear filters" action. Export CSV downloads the currently filtered/sorted rows as a CSV file. Styles in `Screen.module.css` use only design tokens and logical properties, with filters wrapping via flexbox so nothing overflows at narrow widths.

I couldn't run the dev server per the task instructions ("You cannot run the app"), so this hasn't been visually verified in a browser — only checked via the Syntara audit tool (100/100 on both files).
